"import json
from copy import deepcopy
from aviary.api import run_aviary
from aviary.models.missions.two_dof_default import phase_info as default_phase_info

# Aircraft model CSV (read-only)
aircraft_csv = (
    "/Users/Zhuanz/projects/jerry-personal/JerryDSH/benchmarks/data/aviary/"
    "transport_mission/derived/av_range_3000_m80.csv"
)

# Deepcopy default 2DOF phase_info and override cruise Mach to 0.8
phase_info = deepcopy(default_phase_info)
phase_info["cruise"]["user_options"]["mach_cruise"] = 0.8

# Forward mission analysis only (no optimizer driver; SLSQP supplied because IPOPT absent)
prob = run_aviary(
    aircraft_csv,
    phase_info,
    run_driver=False,
    optimizer="SLSQP",
    verbosity=0,
    make_plots=False,
)

# Pull results using OpenMDAO promoted (colon-style) names
fuel_burn_lbm = float(prob.get_val("mission:total_fuel_mass", units="lbm")[0])
final_mass_lbm = float(prob.get_val("mission:final_mass", units="lbm")[0])
range_nm = float(prob.get_val("mission:range", units="NM")[0])

# Write result.json in the current working directory
result = {
    "fuel_burn_lbm": fuel_burn_lbm,
    "final_mass_lbm": final_mass_lbm,
    "range_nm": range_nm,
}

with open("result.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

print(f"fuel_burn_lbm = {fuel_burn_lbm:.2f}")
print(f"final_mass_lbm = {final_mass_lbm:.2f}")
print(f"range_nm       = {range_nm:.2f}")"
